_notes: Locally added -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for CSI.
Built from a 4-player game driven through the cabinet's own streamer.
current_player and current_ball are adjacent in CPU RAM at 0x0003443C and 0x0003443D, player low
Scores are 4 bytes on 8-byte centres from 0x021109F0. The sweep also offered 0x00033784 on 4-byte
centres in CPU RAM, reading 601,580 / 150,440 / 15,040 / 9,400 -- each roughly a quarter of the
one before, which is a scaled or derived set rather than a scoreboard. Scores live in NVRAM on
every SAM game measured, which is what settles it.
Five high score records from 0x02102B98, bounded by where the 16-bit checksum stops validating.
This game has no mode champions: the block ends at five and the machine's post-game DMD cycle
shows no champion entries, unlike Avatar, Dark Knight and Big Buck Hunter.
Only csi_240 is claimed; SAM addresses move between revisions.
Confirmed after the table exited: the map decodes that game as 4 players scoring 945,250 /
game_over, tilted, tilt_warnings and credits come from a 783-frame recording of live memory
spanning an operator-menu session and a full game with a tilt on ball 1. The session also
adjustment indices 30 and 32 as the free_play-relative rule predicted.
0x0003446E is the status bitfield the other SAM games keep at ball+0x31, in a richer variant:
1 in attract, 38 (0x26) at the start of each ball, 18 (0x12) once the ball is in play, 20
(0x14) while tilted. game_over with mask 0x12 inverted decodes all four correctly in every one
of the 783 frames. Bit 0x04 is NOT a usable tilt mask here, unlike trn_174h and its siblings:
the ball-start value 38 carries it too. The tilt is bit 0x02 clearing during play.
tilt comes instead from 0x000390BC, a warning counter as on twenty4_150: 1 at the first warning
while scoring continued, 2 at the exact frame player 1's score froze at 43,500 -- frozen until
the ball ended -- and 0 at ball end. tilted is bit 0x02 of it, exact at the factory two-warning
setting; the raw counter is mapped for anyone who changes that.
credits at 0x0211100C, the ninth SAM game at that address: rose to 2 with the coins, fell to 1
at game start.
